# Obsidian and LM Studio Mac acceptance

## Objective

Add one Mac-bridge acceptance runner for actual Obsidian and LM Studio proofs.

## Required controls

* The Obsidian vault boundary must contain `.obsidian`.
* The note write must be collision-safe.
* Readback and lossless export must produce matching SHA-256 evidence.
* LM Studio model inventory must use its OpenAI-compatible local API.
* One bounded deterministic inference must record model identity, latency, response hashes and token usage.
* Receipt, telemetry and ledger records must remain linked.
* Missing vault or API evidence must block promotion.

## Remaining gate

The authenticated Mac bridge is not yet available to this worker.
The next action is to execute the acceptance command through that bridge.
